sub.zh: 从信息卡片生成待办、周报、知识体系、创作空间
sub.en: Todos, weekly reports, knowledge system, Creation Space. Four outputs, all generated from your info cards.

1b.zh: 待办从信息卡片生成，勾完自动归档，不用另开清单应用
1b.en: Todos come from your info cards and archive themselves when done — no second checklist app.

m2b.en: Fold review conclusions into the report

2b.zh: 按模板把这一周整理成稿，直接使用
2b.en: Your template turns the week into a draft you can use as is.

m3p1.zh: 评审通过：周报先做模板化

m3p2.zh: 客户周五前要回话，排期偏紧
m3p2.en: client reply due Friday, schedule is tight

3b.zh: 自动提取概念和主题，形成可回溯的知识网络
3b.en: Extract concepts and themes into a traceable knowledge network.

5b.zh: 按作品类型定义空间，创作时随时调用自己的资料
5b.en: Define spaces by work type, and call on your own materials anytime while creating.
